page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor and AMD EPYC 7T83 processor architecture. Operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz, the instance supplies 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 128 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include support for AVX, AES-NI, and SHA-NI cryptographic extensions, while AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets are absent. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local storage, necessitating reliance on networked block storage, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid overall compute performance with notable variances across memory operations. Single-core compute capability is strong, demonstrated by high stress-ng single-core outputs and competitive small-model text generation rates. Multi-core compute metrics across Geekbench and PassMark reflect middle-tier throughput consistent with its 16-core physical allocation. PassMark memory testing registers strong results, yet sustained large-block memory writes show a performance bottleneck, placing in the lower quartile at 18.93 GB/s despite solid small-block cached read throughput exceeding 2 TB/s. General application tasks such as static web serving, Clang compilation, and Redis SET operations deliver typical mid-range throughput.

Because the configuration lacks local NVMe disks, overall storage throughput and latency depend entirely on detached block volumes. The ecs.g7a.8xlarge provides a balanced resource allocation that delivers solid CPU-to-memory density without the premium associated with specialized accelerator hardware or high-ratio memory instances. It is functionally suited for general enterprise application hosting, microservice orchestration, medium-scale relational databases, static web serving clusters, and containerized development pipelines that require predictable compute capacity without heavy local write caching requirements.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server powered by a 2.55 GHz AMD EPYC 7T83 processor built on x86_64 architecture. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, it features 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 128 GB of RAM, and an 8 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no local storage or discrete GPUs, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data. Benchmark results show strong single-core compute performance and high PassMark memory marks, though large-block memory write bandwidth demonstrates throughput limitations. Standard multi-core processing, compression, and compilation benchmarks reflect stable mid-tier results. Delivering a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM capacity, the instance is well suited for web serving tiers, application backends, container orchestration, and general-purpose database workloads.
